text: The Patriots prepare to host a Jets team that Garrett Wilson has dubbed a "big-ass game" for New York's divisional aspirations, and the preparation begins in earnest with some significant injury contingencies to manage heading into Sunday at Gillette Stadium. Drake Maye's stellar Week 5 performance—which earned him FedEx Air & Ground Player of the Week honors alongside Jordan Love—will need to sustain itself against a Jets defense known for its blitz-heavy schemes, though the Patriots' offense faces challenges with left tackle Will Campbell sidelined by an MCL sprain to his right knee and running back TreVeyon Henderson expected to miss multiple weeks with a high ankle sprain. The good news arrives on the defensive side, where cornerback Christian Gonzalez declared himself ready to return after missing two games with a shoulder injury, and wide receiver Brown has returned to practice, providing some reinforcement to the Patriots' personnel picture. Both Vrabel and Maye addressed their preparations in Wednesday press conferences as New England looks to maintain momentum in what could be a pivotal AFC East matchup.
